prior_summary: Fresh-TCP incremental correction: diffuse local SE(3) command corrections and re-anchor every executed slot to the freshly measured TCP before IK.
applicable_conditions: Prefer for collision-free entries or replans whose TCP/joints differ from the nominal demonstrated path, including a partly open lid, when lid/handle-relative geometry remains trustworthy and required corrections are locally reachable.
termination_guidance: Terminate from observed open fingers, accumulated TCP clearance, stable open lid and unchanged peg. Preserve causal history at takeover so release and retreat trends remain visible.
limitations: Local labels do not establish recovery from a missed handle or lost contact. Small corrections can accumulate error or stall, orientation corrections may oscillate under bad state estimates, and IK/collision feasibility remains configuration dependent. Use h01 for large assembly displacement and h03 when release phase dominates near nominal placement.
